svg.title: Homepage Topology · Portrait
svg.desc: Portrait node spacing grows with the available height and contracts before nodes are stacked. Center the visible composition vertically when both wings are expanded or one wing is folded. When running tasks exhaust the vertical budget, compact the source wing first and center the task stack vertically. Keep the hub and visible rails at their horizontal positions when folding a wing.
